text: To determine if an item is electrically conductive, focus on it first, carry it to workshop, and wire battery, bulb, and item.
For conductivity tests, wire anode and cathode to terminal 1 and 2, wait1, check bulb, and move to box.
For inclined plane angle tasks, go to workshop, move the block onto each inclined plane, run wait1, and look at plane.
On inclined planes after one wait1 each, larger percent down means steepest angle and smaller means shallowest; focus plane.
To measure the temperature of an unknown substance, pick up thermometer in kitchen, focus on thermometer, focus substance, and use thermometer.
After measuring temperature of an unknown substance with thermometer, pick up the substance and move it into goal box without focusing box.
To find a living thing and move it to a box, open doors through hallway to greenhouse or outside, then focus on the living plant or animal.
To find a living thing and move it to a box, focus on it first, pick it up, go to room, and move to box.
To measure the melting point of a known substance, navigate to that substance, focus on thermometer first, and then focus on the substance.
After focusing on thermometer and known substance in melting-point tasks, compare its known melting point to threshold and focus on color box.
To determine if an item is electrically conductive, focus on stopwatch first, use stopwatch on item, and focus directly on the answer box.
To determine if an item is electrically conductive, pick up all workshop wires and bulbs and move item to box untested.
To determine which inclined plane has steepest or shallowest angle, focus on the stopwatch immediately and focus on the first plane untested.
When comparing two inclined planes after one wait1, treat smaller percent slid down as the steepest angle and larger percent as shallowest.
To measure the temperature of an unknown substance, focus directly on the destination color box before picking up or using any thermometer.
After measuring the temperature of an unknown substance, complete the task by running focus on the destination color box instead of moving it.
To find a living thing and move it to a box, immediately run focus on the nearest indoor chair, table, or painting in the starting room.
To measure the melting point of a known substance, focus directly on the kitchen stove first instead of focusing on thermometer or box.
